answer: Locks are logged in glacier, expire in atlas, and grove lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 190 aliases thus needs 128 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 597 identities would post 662 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
